scope: One exact pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 case, extensions.kitty-graphics.animation. Both pinned callbacks (termless and terminal) are replayed from the retained pinned bundle and are always inconclusive. One separately identified effect contract composes the owned Kitty animation carrier: a retained 16x16 raw RGBA image with three solid frames held 5 s each, a stationary control, playback, loop and stop-freeze, plus half-transparent PNG frames and the root frame as a base and an edit target (chosen with a=a,c=, so no elapsed time is involved), over paired original offscreen PNGs, complete cell/mode reads, fresh raw fences and retained wall-clock brackets. Protocol acknowledgement and painted pixels are separate facts, and elapsed time is the App's own monotonic clock observed on a real desktop, not a synthetic presentation time. One image size, one gap length and one PNG encoding (8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced): no frame-rate or display-refresh cadence, other container formats or PNG encodings, a=c, snapshot/persistent-session replay, remote/mux, other platforms, common-harness or stock-score claim.

effectContract.statement: A retained 16x16 raw RGBA image with two further frames added by a=f (z=5000 ms each, root gap 5000 ms) shows its root frame, stays on it past that gap while stopped, then after a=a,s=3 shows the second frame, the third frame and the root frame again at the times its gaps give (measured by paired offscreen captures against the App's wall clock), and after a=a,s=1 stays frozen on the frame it was showing past a hold that would have advanced it. A half-transparent PNG frame (a=f,f=100) built over the root frame (c=1) shows the protocol's straight-alpha blend of the two when chosen with a=a,c=; after the root is edited (a=f,r=1) and shown again, a second PNG frame built over it shows the blend of the edited pixels instead of the original. Every write is acknowledged OK and every cleared target is blank again.
